name: list_layers
author: hprebar
title: List layers
description: Lists every layer of the active drawing: name, ACI colour index, off/frozen/locked/plottable flags and lineweight (hundredths of a mm as create_layer takes it; -3 = default, -1 ByLayer, -2 ByBlock); optionally the number of model-space entities on each layer. Read-only.

includeCounts.description: Also count the model-space entities on each layer (slower on big drawings)
